_note: Loose directional check for a generic 'explain the extension system' prompt. Each fact is a claim every accurate explanation contains, matched as a co-occurrence inside one sliding window (all patterns match, no `none` pattern matches). reward = matched / total, or 0 below `failBelow`. Report quality is validated by hand; this only gates 'did the agent engage with the core of the system'.

facts.note: Felan builds on @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent's ExtensionAPI; FelanExtensionAPI extends it.
A Felan extension is a callable that receives the extension API (pi).
Packages are dynamically loaded and bound into a running session.
Resolved declarative config is surfaced to the extension as pi.config.
A tool an extension registers reaches the model through the host - the extension calls registerTool (or 'registers a tool') and the host session exposes it to the model.
